author: editorial-builder

brief.readerSituation: A first-time market seller can add up oils and packaging but cannot tell whether saleable bars cover fees, labels, a market table, and their own time.
brief.decision: Set a minimum retail price and production target from full-batch cost and expected saleable yield rather than copying a multiplier.
brief.primaryQuestion: How should I price handmade soap when I know ingredient cost but not true cost per saleable bar?
brief.tension: A cheap-looking price can feel competitive while quietly turning a day of production and selling into a loss.
brief.primaryIntent: how to price handmade soap by cost per bar
brief.originalValue: Work backwards from saleable bars and channel costs with explicit illustrative inputs rather than prescribing a universal markup.
